verdict.rationale: The README leads with a single zero-install command, `npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills`. It also documents flags for selecting a skill (`--skill`), targeting an agent (`-a claude-code`), skipping prompts (`-y`), and confirming the result with `skills list`, so a working install plausibly takes well under five minutes. Missing for 10: a dedicated step-by-step quickstart guide, stated prerequisites (e.g. Node/npx requirements), and hands-on or independent evidence of the actual time to a working skill.
